{{Current events header|2016|06|10}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2015–present)]]
**A blast occurs at a mosque in a small village in the [[Nangarhar Province]], killing four people and injuring nearly 40 more. [http://www.rferl.org/content/afghanistan-nangarhar-mosque-blast-dead/27790774.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
*[[2016 Aktobe shootings]]
**[[Kazakhstan|Kazakh]] [[Law enforcement in Kazakhstan|police]] kill five additional suspected militants in [[Aktobe]] as part of a "counterterrorism operation". [http://www.rferl.org/content/kazakhstan-aqtobe-militant-suspects-killed/27789949.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)] 	
*[[Conflict in the Niger Delta]]
**The [[Niger Delta Avengers]] blow up an oil pipeline operated by [[Italy]]'s [[Eni]] in the [[Niger Delta]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security-eni-idUSKCN0YW1LQ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Manbij_offensive_(2016)|Manbij offensive]]
**[[Kurd]]ish-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces|fighters]] completely encircle the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL-held]] town of [[Manbij]], near the [[Turkey|Turkish]] border, while [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian forces]] move closer to ISIL's de facto capital, [[Al-Raqqah|Raqqa]]. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8f139661a58741f5b96cc3d531437fcf (AP)]

;Business and economy
*[[Gawker Media]] files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after losing an invasion-of-privacy [[Bollea v. Gawker|lawsuit]] brought by former professional wrestler [[Hulk Hogan]], and has sold its blog network to [[Ziff Davis]]. [http://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-06-10/gawker-files-bankruptcy-after-losing-hulk-hogan-privacy-case (Bloomberg)] [http://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/11/business/media/gawker-bankruptcy-sale.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')], [http://www.adweek.com/news/press/gawker-has-filed-bankruptcy-and-says-it-will-sell-ziff-davis-171937 (Ad Week)]
**The bankruptcy [[auction]] for the company gets underway when Gawker accepts [[Technology|tech]] [[Publishing|publisher]] [[Ziff Davis|Ziff Davis's]] bid for all seven of its brands and other assets, reportedly for $90 million to $100 million. [http://money.cnn.com/2016/06/10/media/gawker-media-bankruptcy/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Amazon.com Inc]] is preparing to start a stand-alone [[streaming music]] service, in direct competition with [[Apple Music]] and [[Spotify]], according to sources who spoke to [[Reuters]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-amazon-com-music-exclusive-idUSKCN0YW28U (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*The [[United States Geological Survey]] (USGS) reports a magnitude 5.1 [[Earthquake|earthquake]] strikes near [[Borrego Springs, California|Borrego Springs]], [[Southern California]]. The [[Los Angeles County Fire Department]] and [[Riverside County Sheriff's Department]] say they have received no reports of serious damage. [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/southern-california-earthquake-felt-los-angeles-san-diego-n589476 (NBC News)]
*The [[United States Geological Survey]] also reports that a magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck off the coast of [[Malaita]] island, [[Solomon Islands]]. However, no [[Tsunami|tsunami]] warning has been issued. [http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/306111/magnitude-6-point-2-quake-strikes-near-solomons'-malaita (''Radio New Zealand'')]

;Health and medicine
*A [[artificial heart#SynCardia|SynCardia artificial heart]] enabled a 25-year-old father of three to continue a "normal" life for 555 days without a heart while waiting for a [[Organ transplantation|transplant]]. The [[Ypsilanti, Michigan]], man received the transplant last month, and is recovering at the [[University of Michigan Health System#Main medical campus|University of Michigan Frankel Cardiovascular Center]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2016/06/10/health/artificial-heart-555-days-transplant/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Israel]] temporarily bans all [[Palestinian people|Palestinians]] from entering its territory until Sunday following the [[June 2016 Tel Aviv shooting]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/israel-bars-palestinians-tel-aviv-attack-army-054221645.html (AFP via Yahoo! News)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]], [[Cold War II]]
**[[Russia]]'s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Foreign Ministry]] warns of "retaliatory measures" over the entry of the [[United States Navy]] destroyer, [[USS Porter (DDG-78)|USS ''Porter'']]. The USS ''Porter'' arrived in the Black Sea port of [[Varna]], [[Bulgaria]], earlier this week for what the U.S. Navy called a routine deployment. [http://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2016/06/10/russia-vows-response-us-naval-ships-entry-into-black-sea/85686822/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Cuba–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of Commerce|U.S. Department of Commerce]] approves service by six commercial airlines from five U.S. cities, including [[Miami]] and [[Philadelphia]], to nine international airports in [[Cuba]]. Approval for routes to the capital [[Havana]] are still pending. Most of the carriers plan to begin their new service this fall and winter.  [http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/cuba/article83024922.html (''Miami Herald'')]

;Law and crime
*A [[Maldives]] court convicts  [[Ahmed Adeeb]], the country's former [[Vice President of the Maldives|vice president]], of masterminding a plot to kill [[President of the Maldives|President]] [[Abdulla Yameen]]. He is sentenced to 15 years  in prison. Earlier this week, Adeeb was sentenced to 10 years for [[Criminal possession of a weapon|firearms possession]]. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ee0a33ba0b3042238be040a1c06cc846/maldives-ex-vp-jailed-15-years-attempt-president (AP)]
*[[Christina Grimmie]], a former contestant on ''[[The Voice (U.S. TV series)|The Voice]]'' and  now a singer with [[Before You Exit]], is shot by an unknown male assailant. She was hospitalized in critical condition and pronounced dead hours later due to her injuries. The band was signing autographs following a concert at [[The Plaza Live]] in [[Orlando, Florida]], when the assault occurred. The shooter killed himself while attempting to flee. [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/voice-singer-christina-grimmie-shot-after-florida-concert-n590161 (NBC News)] [http://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/Christina-Grimmie-South-Jersey-Native-and-Voice-Contestant-Shot-After-Orlando-Show-382559891.html (WCAU)] [http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/reported-shot-orlando-concert-venue-article-1.2669516 (Daily News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016]]:
**In a substantial swing, the "Leave" camp is 10 points ahead of "Remain" with less than two weeks to go before Britain's referendum on whether to stay in the European Union, according to a poll by ORB. [http://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/eu-referendum-poll-brexit-leave-campaign-10-point-lead-remain-boris-johnson-nigel-farage-david-a7075131.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Georgia]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[David Perdue]] is criticized for remarks at the [[Faith and Freedom Coalition|Faith and Freedom Coalition’s]] Road to Majority conference in which his quote of [[Psalm 109#Verse8|Psalm 109:8]], "Let his days be few, and may another have his office," appears to be a prayer for [[President of the United States|President]] [[Barack Obama|Barack Obama’s]] death. Perdue says, "It was a little humor and I said it in a way that we were talking about his days as president." [http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/06/10/Sen-David-Perdue-tells-faith-event-Pray-Obamas-days-are-few/2071465585306/?spt=hs&or=tn_us (UPI)]  [http://www.thedailybeast.com/articles/2016/06/10/gop-senator-david-perdue-jokes-about-praying-for-obama-s-death.html (The Daily Beast)]

;Sport
*[[Gordie Howe]], who scored 801 goals, was a six-time [[Hart Memorial Trophy|most valuable player]] during 26 years in the [[National Hockey League]] and won four [[Stanley Cups]] with the [[Detroit Red Wings]], dies at the age of 88. [http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/10/us/gordie-howe-dies/index.html (CNN)]
